introduction: 211info helps people locate Oregon community services. Search by service and location or telephone a specialist for help.
description: 211info helps people locate Oregon community services. Search by service and location or telephone a specialist for help.

sections.who: You can ask for referrals without a benefit approval. Providers assess their own eligibility.
sections.get: The directory covers housing, food, utilities, healthcare and other community needs.

sections.apply:
1. Search or call

    Use 211info, dial 211 or call 866-698-6155.

  2. Explain your location

    Mention access needs and organizations already contacted.

  3. Contact the provider

    Confirm intake, eligibility and availability.
sections.after: Ask for alternatives if a referral cannot meet your needs.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using 211info directory and contact routes. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.
